Start with what is not working

Is your team adapting to the software instead of the software adapting to the business?

When workarounds become the workflow, adding another app rarely fixes the real problem. Sometimes the better move is to design the missing system around how the business actually needs to operate.

01 · Manual workThe same information keeps getting copied, checked and re-entered.
02 · Disconnected systemsYour ecommerce, ERP, CRM, suppliers or internal tools still depend on people to bridge the gaps.
03 · Software mismatchOff-the-shelf tools are forcing the business into a workflow that no longer fits.

What if the system was built around your operation instead?

Build what matters first

Would building less first make the idea safer?

A useful first phase is usually stronger than an oversized “MVP” carrying every feature imaginable. We split the roadmap around value, risk and what needs to be proven.

Phase 01

Core system

Build the smallest complete version that solves the primary business problem.

Phase 02

Automation

Remove repetitive work after the core workflow is stable and understood.

Phase 03

Integrations

Connect the platforms, partners and data sources the system genuinely needs.

Phase 04

Scale & intelligence

Add advanced workflows, reporting or AI when the extra value is clear.

Common questions

Before you bring us the idea.

Do I need a technical specification first?

No. Start with the business problem, workflow or idea. We can help translate it into requirements, phases, architecture and a development plan before the build is approved.

Can you work with an existing platform or MVP?

Yes. A project can begin from an idea, a manual process, an MVP or a live platform that needs integrations, automation, rebuilding or additional modules.

Will you give a fixed timeline and price immediately?

Not responsibly for an unclear project. Once requirements, dependencies, risks and phases are understood, we can propose the appropriate commercial model and provide a development plan with timeline and cost.

Do you use AI in every project?

No. AI should solve a real problem. If a simpler API, rules engine or workflow automation is more reliable and economical, that is often the better answer.

How do project updates work?

Before kickoff we agree a reporting rhythm. Depending on project size, this can include weekly progress reporting and milestone reviews covering completed work, current work, next steps, decisions and risks.

What happens after launch?

The agreed delivery can include production deployment, stabilization, documentation, training and handover. Ongoing support or continuous development can then be arranged separately.

Discuss your idea

Still living in your head?

Tell us what is happening in the business today and what you wish happened instead. We can start there.

If the project looks like a fit, the next step is to understand the workflow, define requirements and map the development path before coding begins.

No technical specification required. For larger or unclear projects, a dedicated Solution Blueprint may be recommended before development pricing is finalized.
